listing.summary: Information only; source hold. Upstream retains the complete-playthrough claim on its i9-12900KF/RTX3090Ti development PC. WIP0.1.4 adds a separate renderer thread, faster rendering, hair fix and more movie skipping, with missing Skip text still noted. Its new renderer has only been played on NVIDIA; AMD RX9070XT evidence is explicitly WIP0.1.3, not0.1.4. Reported development-PC scenes vary about60FPS light/35–45FPS busy/21–25FPS heaviest; shader pauses, crashes, transient deformation, motion drift and graphics defects remain. Renderer_thread=0 is the upstream fallback if new threading regresses. Intel graphics remain untested, native4K/stable60FPS are future goals, and no Portcove gameplay qualification is established. Acquisition is blocked: Preserve Source hold: review closed-source runtime distribution/provenance, including declared game-derived shader programs/icon. README native identity or own disc requirement does not approve that payload. Resume: Expose an information-only same-ID Source hold listing with original CUSA02636/update01.03 and upstream-only maturity; resolve concrete payload/source provenance before any acquisition offer.
